purpose: Pinned numerical coefficients for the native binary64 EM oracle; no model weights, image data or executable native code.
domain: Power exponent exactly 2; exponential argument nonpositive as required by EM. Split range reduction preserves native last-bit behavior.
qualification: 190 native EM cases: 104 maps exact and 86 refusals; separate 100000-value negative exponential and exponent-spanning square probes exact.
sourceNote: M4 compatibility implementation and mathematical constants characterized against the local native reference. Apple ARM exp.s/pow.s in the public Libm repository are empty; no claim that this is an upstream open-source ARM implementation.
